title: Vietnamese Tofu Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with tofu, noodles, and a sweet and savory broth.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: pressed and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes or until they start to soften.
Add the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce (if using) to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles, tofu, and chopped spinach to the pot.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the spinach has wilted.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Optional: serve with additional soy sauce, hoisin sauce, or sriracha on the side.
